game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane, a lane of furriers: the sled courier must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against icicle bats.
theme: Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane: a lane of furriers
core_gameplay_loop: In Furrier Lane, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against icicle bats. Each round, icicle bats strike the ice mill, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the spells value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the ice mill from icicle bats in Furrier Lane: keep the spells meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 51-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: spells drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 51-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Furrier Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against icicle bats in Furrier Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 51 seconds while spells > 0.
